profile.headline: Security Software Engineer at Ford Motor Company
profile.summary: I am currently a cybersecurity software engineer at Ford Motor Company where I assist application teams in securing their code during static and dynamic application security testing.

positions.title: Security Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Languages and tools: FOSSA, Checkmarx, Fortify On Demand, Cycode, Google Cloud Platform, HackerOne 
•	Respond to emerging cyber security trends and lead enterprise-wide vulnerability management efforts
•	Own and manage Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools, process, and reporting 
•	Led Security Advocates group to quickly relay information and security efforts across a broad portfolio
•	Consult with application teams during Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) to ensure security vulnerabilities are resolved 
•	Created scorecards for each organization within Ford Credit Technology and used scorecards to track and remediate vulnerabilities 
•	Oversaw HackerOne bug bounty program, including identifying application suited for the program and paying out the bounties
•	Managed the integration of SAST tools into enterprise CI/CD pipeline, preventing vulnerabilities from being launched into production

positions.title: Agile Team Facilitator and Integration Coach
positions.description:
•	Languages and tools: Rally, Rally On, Microsoft Project, Clarity
•	Manage on-going projects for SQL and Oracle teams using Rally software
•	Manage the migration of Ford’s automated password repository to Beyond Trust Software using MS Project
•	Lead Agile ceremonies
•	Create project plans and road maps, defining high-level yearly and quarterly objectives

positions.title: Ford College Graduate Program Lead
positions.description:
•	The program contains 300 recent graduates who started at Ford Motor Company within the last 3 years. The intention of the program is to develop and place young talent within Ford IT.
•	Oversaw new hire on-boarding and off-boarding of the program 
•	Assigned advisors along with coordinated professional development events 
•	Coordinated role rotation and position availability

positions.title: IT Security Intern
positions.description:
Network Security 
-Monitored the McAfee Network Security Platform 
-Generated McAfee network security reports 
-Maintained and edited Check Point Firewall permission
Mobile Device Management
-Enrolled and monitored devices in VMWare AirWatch  
-Wrote documentation on enrollment process 
IT Operations
-Responded to Help Desk tickets 
-Provided IT Support for physicians

volunteerExperiences.description: The FCG Volunteering  Committee aids various philanthropic organization both nationally and in the Detroit area. Personally, I have been responsible for running fundraisers and organizing events.
